programme.title: Planet Earth
programme.desc: David Attenborough looks at the world's great plains, immense wilderness areas that seem empty, but which support the greatest gatherings of wildlife on earth, including two million gazelles on the Mongolian steppes, and three million caribou in North America. At the heart of all this is grass which is able to survive the baking savannahs of Africa, the frozen tundra of the Arctic, and the Indian floodplains.

programme.title: Timeshift
programme.desc: A celebration of the British seaside holiday experience from its Victorian origins and heyday in the 1950s to its slow decline and attempts at reinvention since. Interviewees including Jonathan Meades, Martin Parr and Bill Pertwee explain the way that the seaside has always been the place we all visit to lose our inhibitions and reveal a different side to ourselves.

programme.title: Tribe
programme.desc: While living with the nomadic Darhad herders of Mongolia, Bruce Parry helps a migrating family move their livestock across a high mountain pass.

programme.title: Planet Earth
programme.desc: Tropical rainforests cover just three percent of the planet yet are home to a huge fifty per cent of the world's species. They are the richest environments on earth but also the most competitive. Travelling through this enchanted world it is possible to see the amazing strategies the inhabitants adopt in order to survive.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot
programme.desc: Joe and Jerry are two innocent musicians who accidentally witness a gangland murder. To get out of town in a hurry and be paid for it, they disguise themselves as women, and join an all-girl band travelling to Florida. All seems to be going well until Joe, as Josephine, starts to fall for Sugar Kane, the band's singer, and Jerry, as Daphne, elicits more interest than he'd like from millionaire Osgood Fielding III.

programme.title: The Life and Death of Peter Sellers
programme.desc: A biographical film about Peter Sellers' turbulent rise from popular BBC radio performer to one of the world's most gifted comedic actors. Propelled by an overly possessive mother, Sellers struggled to reconcile his relationship with women, celebrity and his many selves.

programme.title: Citizen Kane
programme.desc: Frequently voted one of the best films ever made, Orson Welles's masterpiece tells the story of newspaper magnate Charles Foster Kane in a series of flashbacks. A reporter is intrigued by the dying Kane's last word - rosebud - and sets out to find a new angle on the life of one of the most powerful men in America. Nine Oscar nominations resulted in only one award for the outspoken Welles - Best Screenplay.
